title: N. The Tree Problem Is Done For

legend: After listening to Mask by Dream, Asahi decided to start wearing a mask and a green hoodie. Unfortunately, this did not change the fact that she is still failing all her classes. Thus, Asahi now turns to you for help on her test.

In the test, Asahi is given a tree with N(1≤N≤5⋅105)$$$N (1 \le N \le 5 \cdot 10^5)$$$ nodes. The i$$$i$$$th edge in the tree between nodes ui$$$u_i$$$ and vi$$$v_i$$$ has a weight of wi(0≤wi≤109)$$$w_i (0 \le w_i \le 10^9)$$$. The goal is to choose two node disjoint (cannot share any nodes) paths in the tree. Asahi's score will then be min(sum of weight of path 1,sum of weight of path 2)$$$\text{min}(\text{sum of weight of path 1}, \text{sum of weight of path 2})$$$. Asahi wants to score as high as possible on the test, so she asks you to find her maximum possible score.
input: The first line contains one integer T(1≤T≤10)$$$T (1 \le T \le 10)$$$, denoting the number of test cases.
The first line of every test case will contain a single integer N(1≤N≤5⋅105)$$$N (1 \le N \le 5 \cdot 10^5)$$$, the size of the tree.

The next N−1$$$N - 1$$$ lines of every test case will each contain three integers ui$$$u_i$$$, vi$$$v_i$$$, (1≤ui,vi≤N)$$$(1 \le u_i, v_i \le N)$$$ and wi$$$w_i$$$ (0≤wi≤109)$$$(0 \le w_i \le 10^9)$$$, denoting the two endpoints and weight of the i$$$i$$$th edge respectively.
In testcases 15−20$$$15 - 20$$$, there are no further restrictions.
output: For each test case, output a line containing the maximum score Asahi can achieve for that test case.

legend.ai: 听了 Dream 的《Mask》之后，Asahi 决定开始戴口罩并穿一件绿色连帽衫。不幸的是，这并没有改变她所有课程仍然不及格的事实。因此，Asahi 现在向你求助，希望你能帮助她完成考试。

在考试中，Asahi 得到了一棵包含 N(1≤N≤5⋅105)$$$N (1 \le N \le 5 \cdot 10^5)$$$ 个节点的树。树中连接节点 ui$$$u_i$$$ 和 vi$$$v_i$$$ 的第 i$$$i$$$ 条边的权重为 wi(0≤wi≤109)$$$w_i (0 \le w_i \le 10^9)$$$。目标是在树中选出两条点不相交(不能共享任何节点)的路径。随后，Asahi 的得分将为 min(路径 1 的权值之和,路径 2 的权值之和)$$$\text{min}(\text{sum of weight of path 1}, \text{sum of weight of path 2})$$$。Asahi 希望在考试中获得尽可能高的分数，因此她请你求出她可能获得的最高分。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 T(1≤T≤10)$$$T (1 \le T \le 10)$$$，表示测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 N(1≤N≤5⋅10⁵)$$$N (1 \le N \le 5 \cdot 10^5)$$$，表示树的大小。
每个测试用例接下来的 N−1$$$N - 1$$$ 行中，每行包含三个整数 ui$$$u_i$$$、vi$$$v_i$$$(1≤ui,vi≤N)$$$(1 \le u_i, v_i \le N)$$$ 和 wi$$$w_i$$$(0≤wi≤10⁹)$$$(0 \le w_i \le 10^9)$$$，分别表示第 i$$$i$$$ 条边的两个端点和权值。
在测试用例 15−20$$$15 - 20$$$ 中，没有其他限制。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一行，其中包含 Asahi 在该测试用例中能够获得的最高分数。
